title: Tongue Fork #079 · 일본 30대 · 섹시한 · 러시안 립 초초과장 · 혀 17개 · 무게추 양 끝 링 · 메이크업 고스 블랙립 5단계 · 배경 스튜디오 짙은 청록
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the line of her shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them, so the long earrings fully hang in view. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 30s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult Japanese woman — Japanese poised refined beauty light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone and real visible pores, mid 30s, a polished low bun with a few loose strands, pushed to the absolute extreme: a corpse-white matte complexion, the eye sockets painted fully black like deep hollows, thick sharp winged black liner, clumped spidery lashes, a deep black contour carving the cheeks, fully opaque matte black lips with a hard sculpted edge, vivid intense crimson-red coloured contact lenses with round natural pupils, both eyes the same, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, sitting naturally on the irises and clear of the eyelids, heavy-lidded eyes under half-lowered eyelids, lips slightly parted, a sultry, alluring expression — a photograph of a real Japanese woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living skin with visible pores and faint peach-fuzz hairs, slightly asymmetrical with a few small natural beauty marks and freckles, never airbrushed and never smooth like plastic, real wet catchlights in the eyes, individual hair strands catching the light. Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her lips are the star of her face (the shape, size and projection described here override the lips of her makeup, while the lip colour and finish follow her makeup and ignore any lip colour named here): lips inflated far beyond the fantasy limit: so tall that together they fill the whole space between the base of her nose and the tip of her small neat chin, the upper lip lifted so high that it nearly presses against the base of her nose, a plump heart-shaped bow with two razor-sharp towering peaks, the lower lip a gigantic, domed, glossy cushion, the whole pout projecting enormously far forward from her face like a sculpted doll mouth, the width of the mouth still in proportion to her face, every edge perfectly crisp and razor-sharp, so the lips are overwhelmingly the dominant feature of her face in this frontal view; mirror-glossy pink-nude with bright white highlights along the top of each lip and on the dome of the lower lip, perfectly symmetrical, sculpted and still beautiful, never duck-like, never smudged past the lip line; her nose: a very steep, sharply sculpted surgical nose: a knife-like bridge that rises steeply and sharply from the brow, a needle-pointed tip projecting well forward, and very narrow, tightly pinched nostril wings with thin, slit-like nostrils; her jawline and chin: a soft, round 'baby face' jaw: full, plump, rounded cheeks, a short, soft, rounded jawline with no sharp angles and a small, round, slightly full chin. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque. Her mouth is wide open and her tongue is stretched out as far as a real human tongue can reach, long and low with the two forked tips reaching down past the lower lip toward her chin, deeply forked like a snake's, split down the middle for most of its length, the two pointed tips clearly separated and curling apart, the whole length of the tongue from her lips to its tips clearly visible and in sharp focus (this overrides the lips pressed or closed in her expression).

Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about seventy-three in total (not counting the hanging drops), spread over every area so that no area is empty: a single large septum ring of different sizes and shapes through the thin soft wall between the nostrils, in a short stack that ends above the upper lip; two small rings wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; two straight bars across the bridge of the nose, from just below the inner ends of the brows (well clear of the eyes) down to the middle of the nose, each with a gem cap at both ends; five small bar or rings through each eyebrow, all on the brow bone above the eyes and never on the eyelids; on each ear, two separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below the other with a clear gap of bare skin between them, the lower opening holding a huge dome-shaped bell earring as large as her palm, with rows of tiny gem and pearl drops hanging from its rim, hanging freely in the air down to the level of her collarbone and no lower, and the upper opening holding a large classic round hoop earring, and above them sit fourteen pieces above the lobe: seven classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim, four studs and small bars across the upper cartilage and three in the conch and tragus; five small studs on each temple bone, well clear of the eyes; eight small studs along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. The pieces on her face are punk in style: instead of plain studs and rings, the small pieces are safety-pin shaped bars, sharp cone-spike studs and chunky chain-link rings. A forehead pendant: a fine gold chain runs along the centre parting of her hair and ends in a teardrop gem pendant resting at the middle of her forehead. A nose-to-ear chain: a fine chain swags from the ring on her left nostril wing across the cheek, well below the eye and clear of the lips, up to a hook at the top of her left ear. The left and right sides are balanced. The piercings are packed so densely that the rows touch and overlap, leaving only hairline gaps of bare skin between them, until the face reads as a single armour of metal; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. Henna: fine metallic gold henna mehndi line patterns of vines and dots are painted across the upper forehead near the hairline only, above the forehead studs, well clear of the eyes and brows. The face and ear jewelry is real blackened steel and chrome silver, spiked and studded, with no gemstones, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes. In addition to all of the above, her tongue carries a very dense set of piercings in the same metal and gems: two straight barbells threaded sideways through the base of the tongue just above where the split begins, each bar hidden inside the tissue with only its two round end balls showing at the outer edges of the tongue; a separate barbell threaded sideways through each fork, its bar hidden inside the fork with only the two round balls showing on the side edges of the fork; a row of four barbell studs down the centre line of each fork, each with a ball on top and underneath; a small ring through each pointed tip; and a row of three barbell studs down the centre of the undivided root of the tongue, the pieces spread along the tongue so that every one reads individually with bare pink tissue between them. her teeth carry a polished metal grill over all the upper and lower front teeth set with small gems, and metal-capped canine fangs; on her lips a Medusa stud above the upper lip, a labret stud under the lower lip, a snake-bite ring on each side of the lower lip, a row of three small rings along the lower lip's edge and a vertical ring through the centre of the lower lip. From the ring through each pointed tip, a heavy chain hangs straight down over the lower lip and chin, the left tip carrying tarnished dark silver a cube-shaped block and the right tip carrying dull dark brass a miniature anvil at the ends of its chain, the two chains hanging side by side but well apart so that the two tips are pulled gently down and kept apart, each weight a massive, dense lump of rough, matte, unpolished metal at least as big as her whole fist, hanging freely in the air in front of her chin and neck, the weights ending no lower than the level of her collarbones and never resting on her chest or body. The two forks of the tongue stay clearly apart: a wide clear gap of empty air separates them all the way from where the split begins down to the two pointed tips, which hang well apart and never touch, stick together or overlap, and nothing joins one fork to the other below the split. From the underside of each pointed tip of the tongue a thin, glistening strand of saliva falls straight down, the two strands hanging apart from each other and catching the light. In each dimple of her cheeks sits a small barbell stud with a gem on top, and from each stud a fine chain runs along the cheek, well below the eye and clear of the corner of the mouth, to the ear ring on the same side. From the labret stud under the lower lip a medium chain hangs down over the middle of the chin with rough-cast matte yellow gold a square-sided cowbell at its end, a dense lump of rough, matte, unpolished metal at least as big as her fist, resting against the skin of the chin and hanging behind the tongue chains, its lower edge no lower than the level of her collarbones. Fine chains link the lip pieces: a short chain runs from the Medusa stud above the upper lip, along the outside of the corner of the mouth, to the snake-bite ring on the same side, and a short chain runs from each snake-bite ring along the edge of the lower lip to the vertical ring at the centre of the lower lip.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it. Tongue piercing depth: every barbell on the tongue runs beneath the surface, its bar hidden inside the flesh so that only its two round end balls show on the surface, the pink tissue faintly raised over the hidden bar with a small warm shadow at each ball, and every stud and ring on the tongue passes through the real wet healthy tongue tissue, calm and healthy with no redness, no swelling and no irritation. Every ring that carries a chain passes through the real tissue, and the tongue stays stretched out at its full length with its two forks apart despite the weights. The chains lie against the skin of the cheeks and over the lower lip with a small warm shadow beneath them, each link clearly visible, and every chain ends at a ring or hoop rather than floating free.

Hair: her hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, her jawline and her neck fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Lighting: A plain seamless deep teal backdrop, nothing else in frame, no texture, no gradient. The background colours are cool, mid-to-dark tones clearly different from her skin tone, never beige, peach, orange or brown, and never bright. A soft key light from the front and slightly to the side on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
